sourceSelectionBeforeScoring.denominator: All episodes/official publisher text or clips first publicly published in the fixed interval, all named stock mentions including bullish, bearish, no-action, ambiguous and subsequently edited/deleted picks. Verify episode completeness before prices. No guest/show substitution, no source selected from reported winners.
sourceSelectionBeforeScoring.currentAvailability: NOT_VERIFIED; no episode/transcript/video corpus acquired. A series URL is a source locator, not proof of publication completeness or historical edit versions.
sourceSelectionBeforeScoring.researchStatus: Retrospective exploratory audit, not an untouched confirmation cohort; source and date range fixed now before any pick scoring. No prior performance claim.

required: Original publisher episode/page/clip ID and full source link
First-public publication timestamp with timezone and independent archival evidence
Original recommendation wording/context, speaker and every named issuer
Original version/hash and all known edit/deletion/correction timestamps and content
Contemporaneous instrument/CIK/security mapping and share class
Extraction uncertainty, missing episodes/mentions and duplicates retained before outcome lookup
provenance.fallback: No publication time inferred from a page date, upload ordering, a current edited transcript or memory. No bulk video/transcript download, login, paid source or new acquisition under this protocol. Missing original time/version/completeness -> INCONCLUSIVE before score.

classificationBeforePrices.bullish: Explicit affirmative buy/own/add recommendation; retain conditional language and price limits. If a stated condition cannot be verified with timely evidence, no model entry.
classificationBeforePrices.bearish: Explicit sell/avoid; retained as an avoidance cohort, never converted into a short or added to long profit.
classificationBeforePrices.other: Hold/no-action/ambiguous/unmapped/non-US/non-common/duplicate kept with exact disposition, no invented trade.
classificationBeforePrices.duplicates: One first bullish issuer-session attempt; later mentions retained and linked, no repeated position or winner selection.
classificationBeforePrices.halal: Historical owner YES/NO/unknown logged separately; do not infer past approval from current labels. Real-money usability requires valid affirmative owner evidence; the broader exploratory population itself needs a separately approved research scope.

execution.entry: First eligible regular-session SIP BBO at or after09:30 New York on the first session whose open follows the authenticated first-public publication. Quote age<=30s, noncrossed/firm with reviewed conditions and enough displayed shares. Entry deadline09:30:30. A missing/late/halted/undersized window is no feasible entry; never move to a favorable later quote.
execution.decisionLatencyLimit: This is hypothetical next-open availability after publication, not evidence that Stock-2 actually detected/delivered the external pick then. Actual receipt/decision/delivery clocks would be a separate prospective operational evaluation.
execution.entryPrice: Ask plus the applicable unchanged adverse-slippage contract, with historical0.8%/1.2% and small-stock/extended-hours stress views separately required; no cheaper-cost rescue. The source's explicit entry limit must also hold.
execution.quantity: floor((1000-3)/modeledEntryPrice); zero shares is no entry; no fractional shares, borrowed cash or assumed free orders.
execution.primaryExit: Predetermined20th regular-session close after entry, entry session counts as1. Last eligible firm BBO in final30s before that close, at executable bid less applicable adverse slippage; label intended-close quote model, not an auction fill. If halted/unpriced, retain unresolved liquidation and bound loss; do not carry until recovery or replace the case.
execution.sourceExitInstruction: Preserve the source's own exit/target/stop wording for a separately labeled descriptive audit, never select it instead of the fixed primary20-session view based on outcomes. No intraday target/stop price assumed filled.
execution.fees: USD3 for each executed buy/sell order, including extra legs if any; spread embedded in ask/bid once, additional declared adverse slippage; preserve cash dividends, actions, cash conversions, delisting/terminal-value uncertainty, taxes/settlement fees if applicable and known.
execution.account: Independent-unit result is not funded portfolio performance. Overlap/capital/slot and whole-account cash replay required before reporting account drawdown/return; no sum of overlapping trade returns called portfolio performance.

primary: Same stock, non-recommendation regular-session dates, same20-session horizon and execution/cost assumptions
Same-date eligible US common-stock population, same entry/exit clocks, liquidity/halal-scope labels and cost assumptions
comparisons.selectionAlgorithmGate: Exact outcome-blind date matching, eligible universe, weights, tie-breaks, no-lookahead exclusions and missing-control handling must be frozen and independently reviewed before any source extraction or price scoring. This protocol is NOT execution-ready while that algorithm/source population is unresolved. No easier comparator if unavailable.
comparisons.benchmark: SPY same windows and original annualized/capital views, separately labeled; SPY never substitutes for average-stock primary.
comparisons.missingness: All source mentions and failures retained. No positive conclusion with unbounded outcome/control/source omissions.

outputs: Full episode/mention denominator and original/edit provenance with per-field missingness
Complete hypothetical entry-to-exit price/capacity/cost chains including wins and losses
Net expectancy, win/loss magnitudes, cash-inclusive returns, primary-control excess, concentration/remove-two-best and unchanged cost stresses
Account drawdown only if complete capital/mark paths exist; otherwise UNKNOWN, never worst-trade proxy
Uncertainty clustered by publication/issuer/overlap blocks with multiplicity/legacy-trial context; no claim of strategy validation from examples

finiteDecision.stop: Source population/original edit history or mandatory execution/control evidence cannot be supported under an independently reviewed bounded approved scope; do not substitute another source/date or buy access automatically.
finiteDecision.inconclusive: Insufficient independent episodes, unbounded missingness, incomplete original recommendation/clock/price chain or controls. State exact denominator and unknown facts; no automatic range extension.
finiteDecision.continue: Only consider a separately approved feasibility execution if source/controls/entry-exit/cost contracts pass independent review. Finishing this protocol does not authorize a data run or imply positive source performance.
finiteDecision.completeAdequateAudit: Nonpositive net or either primary excess stops the evaluated source-rule claim. Positive means may justify further research only under all unchanged gates and independent review, never live promotion.

budget.preparationAndOldSystemAudit: Included in the existing A/R/D12-hour aggregate; no extra hour or duplicate project.
budget.externalExecution: No execution time/data budget granted. A future request must specify episodes, requests, bytes, storage, rate, dates and holding runout; this retrospective protocol is not that approval.
